tp1_general_rule_1: 1. Wudu Is Not Required for Halq or Taqsir.
tp1_general_rule_2: 2. It Is Not Necessary to Perform Taqsir Immediately After Sa‘i.
tp1_general_rule_3: 3. Halq or Taqsir May Be Performed at Any Location.
tp1_male_item:
Halq: Shaving the Hair of the Head
Taqsir: Trimming Some Hair from the Head, Beard, or Moustache
tp1_female_item: Taqsir: Trimming Some Hair from the Head
tp2_main_rule:
Attention:
A Person in Ihram May Perform Taqsir Personally or Have It Performed by Someone Who Is Not in the State of Ihram.
tp3_ignorance_or_mistake_note: You May Choose Between Halq and Taqsir.
tp3_taqsir_requirement:
Trim Some Hair from Your Head.
Trimming the Nails Alone Is Not Sufficient, as an Obligatory Precaution.
halq_intention:
Intention:
I perform Halq for my own / a proxy Umrah al-Mufradah, seeking nearness to Allah.
halq_shaving_method:
If the Umrah is being performed by proxy:
Afterwards, the proxy should shave his own head personally or have it shaved by someone who is not in the state of Ihram.
It is recommended to begin shaving from the right side of the head.
halq_shaving_dua_title: Recite the Following Supplication During Halq:
halq_shaving_dua_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي بِكُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ نُوراً يَوْمَ الْقِيٰامَةِ
taqsir_intention:
Intention:
I perform Taqsir for my own / a proxy Umrah al-Mufradah, seeking nearness to Allah.
taqsir_method: Then trim some hair from your head, beard, or moustache personally, or have it trimmed by someone who is not in the state of Ihram.
